content.thinking: My test expected pn incorrectly: wire envelope writes PN mod width default1 => PN300 becomes raw44 reconstructed to44 expected0. So row pn44. Canonical expected should pn44 not input300. For the ones with expected value I calculated wrong. Hashok false because Python hdr uses pn=300 but actual is44. Fix tests.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
from canonref import hdr
for level,pn,seed,width in [('I',0,None,1),('I',5,None,1),('I',300,None,2),('I',255,None,1),('I',256,None,2),('I',1000,None,2),('H',300,None,2),('A',300,None,2),('A',65536,None,3),('A',2**40,None,5 if False else 4)]:
    expected=0 if seed is None else seed+1
    body=b'\x01'
    w=envelope(level,pn,body,width=width,phase=(pn&1) if level=='A' else 0)
    rec={'I':None,'H':None,'A':None}
    if level=='I': rec['I']=seed
    elif level=='H': rec['H']=seed
    else: rec['A']=seed
    tr=trace([{'keys':['I','H','A']},datagram(w,(0,))],received=rec)
    r=run(tr)['traces'][0]
    p=r['packets'][0]
    expcan=hdr(level,p['pn'],expected,body,phase=(pn&1) if level=='A' else 0)
    print(level,pn,width,'->',p['status'],'reconpn',p['pn'],'epoch',p['epoch'],'ok',p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(expcan).hexdigest(),expcan.hex())
PY
